The proof establishes all quantifiers; 4096 exact rational triples and exact endpoint families were independently replayed as diagnostics.

value.rationale: The full sharp attainable L-infinity-versus-L2 commutator spectrum is a natural minimal finite atomic test of cross-norm stability of alternating conditional expectations. It quantifies a strong endpoint/Hilbert mismatch for arbitrarily small Hilbert commutators and proves the complete interval at each fixed Hilbert norm, rather than a single easy counterexample or generic norm-2 triangle bound. This gives an exact boundary example for transferring Hilbert angle estimates to endpoint regimes.
